newsitem.title: USA: Lodgenet adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Lodgenet adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: LodgeNet Entertainment Corp said Monday its directors adopted a stockholder rights plan.

"The plan is intended to maximize shareholder value by providing flexibility to our Board in the event that we receive an offer for the company that is either inadequate or not in the best interest of all shareholders," said Tim Flynn, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
This plan provides stockholders with special purchase rights under certain circumstances, including if any person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the company's common stock.
Adoption of the plan was not taken in response to any action by another company or party, a LodgeNet spokesman said.

"This is an action our Board has been considering for almost a year, given our expanding growth opportunities, and it takes a basic form used by many other public companies," Flynn said in a statement.
LodgeNet provides video on-demand, network-based video games, digital basic and premium television programming and other interactive, multimedia entertainment and information services to hotels.
